title: The Bonded Flight
logline: When a regional flight academy bundles cadet indentures into traded corporate debt, cadet pilots seize an ore staging base across the jump gate.

roles.description: Administers the regional flight academy; treats cadet training as a high-margin structured finance asset.
A top-ranked third-year flight apprentice leading the cadet strike after discovering their debts were tripled.
An armed heavy cutter deployed by the refinery syndicate to blockade striking cadet berths.
The academy rector's armored executive transport equipped with escort interceptors.
A prestigious orbital flight academy campus in the central core system.
A gritty fuel and ore depot two jumps away where the striking cadets have barricaded themselves.
The collective body of apprenticed flight cadets striking across the sector.
The heavy industrial cartel holding liens on cadet indentures.

public_situation: Flight cadets across three systems have walked out of cockpits, idling fuel convoys while the academy threatens forfeiture of pilot licences.
private_truth: The academy rector secretly sold cadet tuition bonds to refinery cartels at impossible interest rates, turning flight schooling into indentured labour.

beats.public_change: The flight academy declares the cadet strike illegal and freezes student bank accounts.

missions.reason: The rector hires an outsider to courier sealed indenture contracts to the system court before cadets can file for arbitration.
missions.private_fact: The contracts contain predatory clause riders doubling interest rates every thirty solar cycles.

beats.public_change: Cadets seize an outer-system staging depot, cutting off refinery fuel shipments.

missions.reason: The spokesman needs replacement life support scrubbers bought from a civilian station to keep the barricaded cadets from freezing.
missions.private_fact: The cadets are down to three days of oxygen and their training craft lack jump fuel to escape.

beats.public_change: The debt syndicate dispatches security cutters to starve out the cadet depot.

missions.reason: The spokesman asks the pilot to destroy the security patrol cutter enforcing the supply blockade around the depot.
missions.private_fact: The patrol commander is authorized to open fire on unarmed cadet hulls if the depot does not surrender by nightfall.

beats.public_change: The rector arrives at the gate junction on an armed inspection cutter to negotiate terms.

missions.reason: The spokesman needs the pilot to scan the depot's master comms transponder to extract the bond trading ledger.
missions.private_fact: The ledger names the refinery conglomerate as the majority debt collector holding the academy liens.

beats.public_change: Cadet sympathizers gather outside the central academy campus as regional arbitration convenes.

missions.reason: The spokesman asks the pilot to clear the final academy interceptor escorting the rector's transport.
missions.private_fact: The flagship captain hails mid-fight, offering full indemnity and debt cancellation if the pilot surrenders the bond ledger.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the bond ledger before the regional arbitration board. The cadets demand full charter liberation, while the syndicate offers to buy the debt ledger at triple face value.

options.label: Deliver the ledger to arbitrators to dissolve the indentures and certify the cadets
Sell the ledger to the conglomerate representatives in exchange for a hefty payout
Form an independent cadet pilot co-operative under mutual insurance terms

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the bond ledger to the arbitration board.
resolutions.summary: Arbitrators cancel the predatory tuition debt; {role:cadet_corps} earns full flight certification while {role:academy_rector} faces trial.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke the debt ring that turned student pilots into refinery slaves.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers an independent cadet flight cooperative.
resolutions.summary: {role:cadet_corps} breaks away to form an autonomous transport union, buying out their hulls through collective freight hauling.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the academy payoff or sells the ledger to the syndicate.
resolutions.summary: {role:refinery_conglomerate} enforces the bond contracts; striking cadets are blacklisted and reassigned to hazardous refinery runs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the missions or abandons the cadets.
resolutions.summary: Deprived of supplies, the cadet depot surrenders; {role:refinery_conglomerate} locks the students into lifetime indentures.

loose_threads.detail: Secondary exchange boards show cadet debt tranches bundled under an offshore shell corporation registered in another sector.
Confiscated cadet transponder keys carry digital signatures matching a private security firm rather than the civil aviation registry.

radio_hooks: Cadet pilot walkout in {system} enters fifth day, halting commercial grain runs.
{role:academy_rector} threatens criminal breach of contract suits against striking students.
Refinery unions express solidarity with student navigators occupying orbital depot.

voice_direction.academy_rector: Cultivated, condescending, speaking with the icy bureaucratic assurance of a corporate financier discussing yield.
voice_direction.cadet_spokesman: Fierce, exhausted, speaking with raw youthful intensity and sudden bursts of technical cockpit jargon.
